page.title: Organizer profile
page.description: Complete your profile before creating events. Use the tabs below; document and gallery files upload to the organizer API, and other changes apply when you save.

incomplete.title: Incomplete.
incomplete.body: Upload your organization document and at least one gallery image (URLs are saved to your profile), add venue capacity & facilities, and complete your organizer details. Use Save profile at the bottom after edits.

complete.title: Profile complete.
complete.body: You can create and publish events.

fields.profilePhotoHint: Your account photo (JPEG, PNG, GIF, or WebP — max 4 MB). Separate from your public business logo.
fields.businessLogoHint: Public organizer logo for listings and branding — not your personal profile photo.
fields.facilitiesHint: Add amenities (Enter or Add), required for a complete profile.
fields.organizationDocumentHint: PDF or image — uploads immediately to the organizer API, then the public URL is stored when you save the profile.
fields.galleryHint: Each image uploads to the organizer API when selected; public URLs are appended to your profile. Remove items you do not want, then use Save profile to persist the gallery list.

upload.profilePhotoSubtitle: JPEG, PNG, GIF, or WebP — max 4 MB
upload.logoSubtitle: PNG, JPG, or WebP — max 4 MB
upload.organizationDocumentSubtitle: PDF, scan, or photo of CR / permit (max 12 MB)

map.coordinatesHint: Values are stored when you save the profile.

organization.socialSaveHint: Social links are saved via the organizer API when you click Save profile at the bottom of the page.

errors.regionsLoadFailed: Could not load regions. Check API base URL and try again.
